resources.string: I certify that I will use AndroMITM only on systems and networks I own or have written authorization to test (pentest engagement, lab, teaching). I am solely responsible for my usage. Intercepting other people\'s traffic without authorization is a crime.

Attack modules stay locked until this statement is accepted. Everything you do stays on this device.
Root is required to run the engine (su).

Select at least one target in the Targets tab first.
Full path to an alternative bettercap binary (e.g. aarch64 build installed via Termux) for 64-bit-only devices. Leave empty to use the embedded engine.
Redirect selected targets\' traffic through this device

Show HTTP requests/responses and credentials metadata
Tick the boxes of the devices you are authorized to test — they become ARP spoofing targets.

For HTTPS flows, install the engine CA certificate on the TARGET device (Settings → Security → More security settings → Encryption & credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate). The certificate is served by the engine when it first intercepts HTTPS; you can also pull it from the engine\'s folder. Apps with certificate pinning will not be intercepted.
